methodology.nativeDefinition: Tokenized once; shared local automata; typed transient memory; complete token consumption; structured failures; zero legacy fallback.
methodology.conservativeRule: No card is marked native without direct recognizer-path evidence. Missing evidence is null plus verificationStatus=unverified, never guessed.
methodology.granularity: The retained audit is card-level. Entries do not claim per-ability certification.
